conventions.tiers: the kit's device tiers (minimal, economy, balanced, high) map to three feature levels; high on a phone uses medium
conventions.features: terrainSet names the level set in scene.json terrain.sets and terrain.water. water.displaceRadius is the radius (m) of vertex displacement (0 = normals only); displacedWaves the count of the longest Gerstner waves that displace vertices; fragmentWaves the count shaded per pixel; grid, tile0 and levels shape the geometry clipmap (quads per tile side, finest tile in metres, level count); depthContact enables scene-depth foam at piers and fenders. waveFade (Low only) is the view-distance range (m) over which the per-pixel Gerstner waves fade out, their slope variance becoming roughness in the environment reflection: four waves of nearly one direction otherwise sum to regular parallel bands across the bay at mid distance (fix round 1, SCENE-REVIEW-1 item 2); High and Medium omit it. traffic.lod holds the LOD1, LOD2 and cull distances (m) at a 50 degree vertical field of view (owner contract: LOD1 from about 60 m, LOD2 from about 250 m, cull at 1.5 km; Low shortens them). traffic.perLaneMax caps each lane; fix round 2 doubled it with the lanes (4,011 m of route instead of 2,066 m of deck), about 11 % above the steady count of the slowest lane (19 m/s) at the density's mean headway. traffic.contactShadow is the peak opacity of the soft contact shadow drawn under each vehicle at LOD0 and LOD1 on levels without a shadow map (0 = none; data/BEHAVIOUR.md section 1). bridgeFarSwitch is the distance (m) beyond which the far bridge model replaces the near one. shadowExtent is the range of the sun shadow box half-size (m): 0.75 x the camera's distance to its focus, clamped to [min, max] and stepped in 1.25x increments. vegetation.density is the share of the vegetation impostor candidates kept (layout.json dressing.vegetation, near representation only); vegetation.fade the camera distance range (m) over which the kept cards shrink away.
